items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: They had a fellow by the name of Manuel, he was playing bass.

ctx.x: They had drums, bass, trombone, trumpet?

They had a fellow by the name of Manuel, he was playing bass. The drum player was a people named Bruce Aldo, Burrow, Roosevelt Burrow was a drummer. He had goat hires on the drum, we had that on the goat hires because they couldn't get the hair and the goat hires for the drum.
Did you get paid you say?
